journey.name: app status emergency exit
journey.description:
While an emergency exit is active, App Status shows the force transfer on the "Lightning Provider (Spark)" row under Lightning Connection, with a yellow warning icon. It reads "Fee funding needed" while the exit asks for fee funding and "Force transfer to savings in progress..." otherwise, including while a payment that covers the funding waits to confirm. The row opens the exit's progress screen. With no active exit the row shows Spark's connection again. An exit paid from savings cannot be cancelled and runs for days, so the row's return to the connection once an exit ends is covered by unit tests, not here. On iOS, OK on the progress screen returns to the wallet home screen from any entry point, App Status included. An exit takes Spark off the Lightning rail, so with no usable channel Lightning Connection stops reading "Using Spark" while it runs.
Precondition: Debug build on regtest with Spark connected, a Spark balance and savings that can pay the exit's fee funding. The wallet has no Lightning channel. Start an emergency exit from Spark (spark emergency exit journey), pick "Pay from savings" (id "SparkExitFundSavings") and swipe to start it. Starting an exit takes the Spark balance out of Spending for days, so use a throwaway wallet. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap the menu button (id "HeaderMenu") and tap App Status (id "DrawerAppStatus")

Verify the "Lightning Provider (Spark)" row (id "Status-spark_exit") sits under Lightning Connection (id "Status-lightning_connection") and reads "Force transfer to savings in progress...", since savings paid the funding
Verify Lightning Connection (id "Status-lightning_connection") reads "No open connections", not "Using Spark"
Tap the row and verify the exit's progress screen opens
Tap "OK" (id "SparkExitProgressOk") and verify the wallet home screen shows
Open App Status again from the menu and verify the row (id "Status-spark_exit") still reads "Force transfer to savings in progress..."
